model_config.label: Linear isolated-BEV nested logit

utility_specification.purchase_price: linear real-2024 purchase price divided by 10000
utility_specification.technology: drivetrain-specific S-curve normalized to zero in 2024
utility_specification.asc_calibration: ASCs calibrated to observed 2024 shares; gasoline ASC fixed to 0

notes: GUI exports include three selectable elasticity sets: conservative_fridstrom, central_xing_vesterberg, and high_response.

Technology scenarios are calibrated under the adopted default selection: adopted purchase-price policy, adopted fossil-tax base, adopted CPI indexation setting, no GDP indexation, adopted electricity tax, and the adopted ETS2 price path.
EU ETS2 is exposed as a separate fossil-fuel-tax policy lever with adopted, high-market, and off choices.
Electricity tax and electricity VAT are exposed as a separate electricity-price policy lever. The electricity product-price base is SCB handelspris plus nätpris.
